tools.name: profile_message
tools.description: Send a message to another profile and wait up to block_ms for its final answer. If the profile answers in time you get the answer; otherwise (it is still working, or busy and your message waits its turn) you get an id and the message goes on: use the async tool to wait for, list, inspect or stop it. That profile keeps its own conversation between calls, so a later call can build on an earlier one.

profile.description: Profile to message; one of the available profiles.

message.description: The message to send. The profile sees nothing of this conversation.

block_ms.description: Most time to block for the answer. If the profile has not answered (or is busy and the message waits its turn) an id is returned; collect it with the async tool.
